remaining_limits: Microsoft Excel COM unavailable on tested runner/user hardware. LibreOffice parity, old-source validator acceptance and Windows mocks do not establish actual Excel opening/recalculation/freeze timing or end-to-end .2 Excel operation.

No real S3/PLC/lamp writes or long-duration thermal/equipment validation. Final algorithm approval and real equipment use remain on hold. This review does not bypass existing manual approval or device guards.

Normal-looking stale sensor values and emissivity/bias cannot be independently resolved from CSV/slice plans. Images do not prove actual binder deposition, sensor ROI alignment or physical dryness. Missing means unknown.

Abrupt-drop guard does not improve cases without qualified detector evidence (e.g. gradual/shifted/missing-plan cases remain legacy). Finite model-grid results are not universal robustness guarantees.

Powder-hold policy deliberately gives D=C during binder/unknown even when hot. It cannot correct such temperature disturbances until a known-powder interval. Nominal constant-IR performance depends on initially balanced plant.
